findings.description: Diagnostic Standard of Care Deficiency: Empiric inpatient treatment for Community-Acquired Pneumonia initiated without chest radiography (CXR) to confirm infiltrate and rule out effusion.
Discharge summary lacks documented imaging rationale or radiographic follow-up instructions.

explainedTerms.definition: Frontal and lateral thoracic X-rays required by ATS/IDSA guidelines to diagnose community-acquired pneumonia and exclude mimics.
Initial antimicrobial treatment initiated before definitive microbiological pathogen identification.
